body: Welcome!  Make sure you set you Lineup prior to Wed game if you want to start any SEA or NE players.
Otherwise, you can keep switching as long as players you want haven't yet started playing.
I had to fix a couple of bugs I found but scores should be reflected correctly now.  Please let me know if you find anythings that are not looking right.
So far if you had picked Smith-Njigba, he is leading the pack in scores and if he ends up with the top score, you are in line for the weekly MVP bonus of 25 points!
